title: Conformance: settle a real Engram-shaped checkpoint receipt carrying 32-hex ids, one validator per id kind
outcome: Conformance: settle a real Engram-shaped checkpoint receipt carrying 32-hex ids, one validator per id kind
acceptance: A TermAl test settles a checkpoint receipt produced by real Engram producer code or provenance-preserved Engram wire (ids generated at test time, current 32-hex and legacy 64-hex, no pinned hashes) through the real TermAl consumer and asserts the persisted association and GET projection

Each id kind crossing that path is validated by exactly one owner validator per side (record ids by is_engram_record_id, fingerprints by the SHA-256 validator), with the w-fec83085cff0 narrow fix as the first slice
Exact-input focused tests, the full five-stage gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding
